about: The commits a cassette of the core generalization's equivalence goldens may be recorded on (Step S01 of docs/proposals/generalize_core_design.md): the old code, before any production commit of round B. A cassette carries the commit it was recorded on (key `commit`, written by tools/golden_record.py); tests/golden/test_golden_order.py checks it is listed here and that the listed commits have the same robot_agent/ tree as `old_code`.
